name: Hologram
prompt: The person turns into a glowing translucent cyan hologram with scanlines, flickering wireframe edges and glitchy data particles, a bright holographic glow reflecting on the surroundings, cinematic VFX shot, the person stays in the same place and the camera, lighting and background match the original footage
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, warped body, flickering, watermark, text, subtitles, cartoon, deformed hands
